notes.note: Fix round 6 of the delivery-state change: a remote-change pass starts only when a row the previous projection showed held back by an earlier row of its chat becomes sendable here (no longer on every notice, which re-sent a busy chat's message until it failed); that pass only sends (no reconcile, no syncHeld); a durable replay into a running turn returns deferred instead of not-invoked, so it spends no attempt (useActiveChatSessionMessaging.ts); a renderer whose lock request fails is recorded in a bounded localStorage list and read as unknown liveness, never gone (outboundQueueLease.ts); claimNext marks its claim in flight before announcing it. Rewrote the cross-window paragraph: a notice sends only a message newly freed from behind an earlier one of its chat, not one held back by a running turn; that send asks Station nothing and re-holds nothing; a message tried while a turn runs waits without using up an attempt. Checked against the same code and the new tests in useOutboundQueueFlush.test.ts and useActiveChatSessionMessaging.test.ts.
